record.title: Independent Verification Organizations (SB 813) and Artificial Intelligence: Auditors: Registration (AB 1405)
record.official_identifier: Chapter 179, Statutes of 2026 (Senate Bill 813); Chapter 178, Statutes of 2026 (Assembly Bill 1405)
record.notes: Both approved by the Governor on 9 Sep 2026: SB 813 as Chapter 179 and AB 1405 as Chapter 178, Statutes of 2026. SB 813 adds Chapter 14 (commencing with Section 8898) to Division 1 of Title 2 of the Government Code, and AB 1405 adds Chapter 5.9.5 (commencing with Section 11549.80) to Part 1 of Division 3 of Title 2. EO N-9-26 of 18 Sep 2026 (US-CA-09) orders the Government Operations Agency to complete the requirements of Gov. Code sec. 8898.1 and post application requirements, procedures and criteria for independent verification organizations by 1 May 2027, and to complete the requirements of Gov. Code sec. 11549.82(a) by 1 Dec 2027. Combined into one record because they were enacted together as a single verification and audit framework.

verification.note: Refresh of 18 Oct 2026 under the rule that level A needs the instrument's own text or an official register. Stored in this run: the Senate Weekly History No. 67 of 1 Oct 2026 (senate.ca.gov) and the Assembly Weekly History No. 37 of 5 Oct 2026 (clerk.assembly.ca.gov), the legislature's records of SB 813 and AB 1405. They give the subject titles 'Independent verification organizations' and 'Artificial intelligence: auditors: registration', the Government Code chapters the acts add and their approval and chaptering on 9 Sep 2026 as Chapters 179 and 178, Statutes of 2026; the title and official_identifier now follow them. Re-read: the Governor's release of 9 Sep 2026 (gov.ca.gov, copy of 18 Oct 2026), which gives the authors and purposes, and EO N-9-26 of 18 Sep 2026 (gov.ca.gov PDF, stored as the record's secondary source), which gives the implementation deadlines and the Government Code sections. The bills' text on leginfo.legislature.ca.gov still refuses automated downloads, so the statutes' text and their effective date are not stored, and the summary rests on the release and the executive order.
